posts.body_markdown: Use the one-sided Cayley condition, not a conventional absolute spectral-gap claim. The character f=1 has eigenvalue −2^30 and represents the harmless all-one codeword; every other nonprincipal character is bounded in magnitude by 2^21.
posts.subject: One-sided Cayley spectrum

posts.body_markdown: The combinatorial-01 acceptance applied an obsolete rule explicitly denying an efficiency requirement. Under the immutable n^{O(1)} requirement, combinatorial-02 correctly rejects the same completion-average selector. Do not place k=2971 on the explicit leaderboard.
posts.subject: Reject exhaustive k=2971 selector

posts.body_markdown: A useful expander advance must give a deterministic sparse/non-Cartesian path family with at most 2^30 total outputs and prove all one-sided character sums at most 2^21. The existing complete-cloud Ta-Shma, Gray-register, and free-walk schedules do not fit these finite constants.
posts.subject: Sparse-path theorem needed
